figures.finding: A state-subsidised film and audiovisual director in Cuba is paid a monthly salary by artistic evaluation level: group XVIII (7,350 pesos a month on a 44-hour week) at level 1, XVII (7,045) at level 2 and XIV (6,130) at level 3, from 1 July 2026.

value.instrument: Resolución 23/2026 with Resolución 15/2026, Ministerio de Trabajo y Seguridad Social
value.role: Asesor de cine y audiovisuales, director de cine y audiovisuales

figures.applies: Cuba; directors employed as subsidised artists (ICAIC and the other authorised systems); an independent creator in the Registro del Creador Audiovisual is not paid on this scale; no guaranteed period or cut right is set.
